title: Interchanging two finite expectations
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $H:\Omega\times\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The two iterated expectations agree when the order of averaging is reversed: $\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\pi}\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\pi}[H(x,y)]=\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\pi}\mathbb{E}_{x\sim\pi}[H(x,y)]$.
hypotheses_covered: probability mass function used for both averages
real-valued function on the product sample space
